sections.title: de Finetti representation on standard Borel spaces

missing_pieces.duty: ED26-P15-CH-exchangeability-and-definetti-C001 (partial): Worked boundary not supplied. The definitions and hypotheses of E_n, E, T, exchangeability and A_{n,k} are present (body 15-43), and the Durrett and Feller definitions are preserved. Neither the entry nor any text tied to it works a boundary case: no non-exchangeable law, no strict E_{n+1} inside E_n or T inside E, no A_{n,k} edge. The remarks at body 26 and 29 are clarifications, and no reason is given for the field being inapplicable.

ED26-P15-CH-exchangeability-and-definetti-C002 (partial): Worked boundary not supplied. The statement (body 45-55) and the full written annex proof (annex 4-36) are present. No boundary case of the lemma is worked anywhere: no strict inclusion of T in E or of E_{n+1} in E_n, and no case showing what the canonical reduction does not give. Annex 34-35 only states a scope limitation.

ED26-P15-CH-exchangeability-and-definetti-C003 (partial): Worked boundary not supplied. The statement (body 57-68) and the written proof (annex 39-62) are complete and extend Durrett's bounded case to integrable phi. Neither the integrability hypothesis nor the per-integrand null-set caveat (body 67) is worked at its boundary. The only worked integrability failure on the route (w02b-p15-022 body 904-906) is presented as thm:p15-reverse-strong-law's boundary and is not tied to this entry.

ED26-P15-CH-exchangeability-and-definetti-C009 (partial): Worked boundary not supplied. The definitions of P(S), the evaluation sigma-field, the determining class, the kernel, Lambda, sigma(K) and G^P are present (body 154-174). The construction of the determining class is written (annex 291-299). No boundary of these notions is worked: no G^P strictly larger than G, and no case where the standard Borel hypothesis is needed. Body 172 is a clarification only.
